selectFile: Select a .pnt file to view invariants.
pDesc: P-invariants are sets of places whose weighted token sum stays constant in every reachable marking. Full coverage means every place belongs to at least one P-invariant.
tDesc: T-invariants are firing sequences that, from a given marking, return to the same marking. Full coverage means every transition takes part in at least one T-invariant.
conservativeAndBounded: The net is conservative and structurally bounded.
derivedDesc: A net is structurally bounded if there is an upper bound of tokens for each place, regardless of the initial marking. It is conservative if the total number of tokens stays constant.
subTitle: Sub-invariants
psubDesc: Weighted token sum that never increases: it stays at or below its initial value in every reachable marking.
psurDesc: Weighted token sum that never decreases: it stays at or above its initial value in every reachable marking.
tsubDesc: Firing counts whose net effect on the marking is never positive (C·x ≤ 0): repeating them can only drain tokens.
tsurDesc: Firing counts whose net effect on the marking is never negative (C·x ≥ 0): repeating them can only add tokens.
noOneSide: None beyond the exact invariants listed above: every one-sided invariant found has zero residual, so it is already shown there.
basisDesc: These independent vectors span every integer invariant, including combinations with negative entries that no semiflow has. Dimension = size − rank = {dimension}.
basisEmpty: The only invariant is the zero vector.
